value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete invariant-measure simplex and all Koopman spectral groups for a canonical, naturally motivated resonant Boolean factor of Sturmian dynamics. It proves an interval-wide collapse of distinct joining phases for short windows, proves that equal density need not give equal ergodic laws for long windows, and locates exactly one nontrivial measure-theoretic degree-two spectral exception. These infinite-family structural features, not the finite sampling alone, supply the mathematical value.
